summary: At an 18 pt interface size in a 461 x 490 window, History keeps Columns, Latest, Previous and Older whole in its column, the inspector's Copy message and Hash stay above Changed files in History and Compare, also where Hash wraps (560 x 600), with the Changed files count whole inside the inspector, and Changes' filter field stays inside the window, focused or not; at 13 pt the 461 x 490, 493 x 526, 1000 x 680 and 1480 x 800 windows draw as the base does
limitations: Linux under XWayland at scale factor 1 with Mutter input. GNOME keeps the app's 1000 x 680 window minimum, which tiling window managers ignore, so every launch lowers it to 400 x 420 before its first resize. Coordinator decision (2026-10-03, delegated by the owner): the contract's 'Hash toolbar wrapped' is taken at 560 x 600 at 18 pt, since the candidate's 156 px inspector at 461 x 490 keeps the icon-only Copy message and Hash on one row and wraps only from 560 px (its view test asserts both); at 560 x 600 the base also wraps without overlapping. The filter field's caret blinks every 500 ms and shows only while the window is active, so the 18 pt focused crops show either phase and a recheck can differ at the caret alone; the 13 pt focused states are measured against the base with the caret masked, not committed. At 18 pt in 461 x 490 Compare's diff still gets no line; the vertical chrome is the next task. AT-SPI was not read. macOS, native Wayland, Hyprland and fractional scale factors are not covered
